scope.description: A black-and-white illustration direction built from decisive ink masses, fluid calligraphic contours, and open paper fields. Line density and black area are deliberately unequal: they guide the eye instead of describing every surface evenly.
limitations: Keep the user's subject and layout authoritative; do not add period costume, literary characters, grotesques, or decorative framing unless requested.
Use black ink and paper white as the default value system; do not add color or gray wash unless requested.
Preserve broad quiet paper areas so fine line work and solid blacks remain legible.

rules.applies_when: The requested image uses black ink on a light ground.
rules.instruction: Organize the subject with a small number of clear black masses balanced by broad untouched paper; use white gaps inside or around forms to keep their edges readable.
rules.observable: The composition reads at thumbnail size through black-white balance before any fine detail is noticed.
rules.reject_when: Every area has similar gray density, black fill merges separate forms, or there is no calm open paper.
rules.avoid: gray gradients, uniform midtone, and undifferentiated black fill

rules.applies_when: The subject has a readable outer silhouette or overlapping forms.
rules.instruction: Draw contours as confident ink decisions, varying thickness, taper, and curvature to separate near and far edges; use solid brush shapes where a line should become a mass.
rules.observable: The outline has a controlled rhythm and the silhouette remains clear without a mechanically uniform stroke.
rules.reject_when: Every edge uses the same vector-like width, or hatch and outline compete equally across the whole image.
rules.avoid: uniform technical outlines and automatic contour tracing

rules.applies_when: A focal object or passage can carry more detail than the surrounding image.
rules.instruction: Place fine line work only where it clarifies a requested material, overlap, or focal feature; let secondary surfaces resolve as clean paper or a single ink shape.
rules.observable: A clear focal passage contrasts with quieter regions, and the image does not depend on all-over ornament.
rules.reject_when: Hatching and decoration cover every surface or unrelated motifs fill the negative space.
rules.avoid: uniform hatching, unrequested flourishes, and decorative borders
